entities.summary: Alejo Zavala Castro was a Mexican Roman Catholic prelate. He was Bishop of Tlapa from 1992 to 2005 and of Chilpancingo-Chilapa from 2005 to 2015. Zavala Castro died on 2 November 2025 at the age of 83.
